support.subtitle: Our support team is available 24/7 to resolve service listing or contract issues.

q1.question: What is Maqsad?
q1.answer: Maqsad is a premium, collaborative B2B marketplace matching verified professional service providers with enterprise-grade clients. Our platform streamlines scoping, bidding, messaging, and agreement tracking.

q2.question: Is there a subscription fee for providers?
q2.answer: Maqsad offers both free and premium subscription tiers. The free tier lets you list standard catalog offerings, while premium provides advanced analytics, matching scores, and higher visibility.

q3.question: How do I list my B2B offerings?
q3.answer: Click the 'Post New Service' button in your sidebar. Complete the multi-step form by entering your title, description, budget ranges, and estimated days to deliver.

q4.question: Can I edit an active service listing?
q4.answer: Yes, you can edit your listings at any time. Go to your Dashboard overview, find your service post, and click 'Edit Specifications'.

q5.question: How do client booking requests work?
q5.answer: Clients browse your listed offerings. If they have a project matching your specialty, they submit a custom proposal specifying their maximum budget and requirements. You can review all submissions in 'Proposal History'.

q6.question: Can I negotiate budget rates with clients?
q6.answer: Yes! Use the built-in direct messaging portal. Click the chat icon on any proposal to negotiate terms, schedules, and deliverables in real time before accepting the project.

q7.question: How do I start a contract?
q7.answer: Once terms are finalized, go to your 'Proposal History' and click 'Accept' on the client's request. This automatically establishes an active contract, which you can track in your 'Contract Manager'.

q8.question: How are project milestones tracked?
q8.answer: Inside the Contract Manager, each active agreement displays a multi-phase delivery checklist (Scoping, Execution, Final Delivery) to align work stages with client expectations.
